prompt: Who is the first Republican president of the United States to serve non-consecutive terms?
answer: Donald Trump is the first Republican president to serve non-consecutive terms. He served as the 45th president from 2017–2021 and became the 47th president in 2025, after Grover Cleveland, the first president overall to do so.
